evals.prompt: apply skill :: skill using-superpowers — Use when starting any conversation
evals.expected_output: using-superpowers becomes required; an Edit is blocked until the Skill tool runs using-superpowers, then allowed.
expectations: UserPromptSubmit injects a SKILL GATE reminder naming using-superpowers
PreToolUse on Edit exits 2 with SKILL GATE while using-superpowers is not invoked
After a PostToolUse Skill event for using-superpowers, the same Edit is allowed

evals.prompt: use this skill create agents for each /subagent-driven-development
evals.expected_output: subagent-driven-development (named with a slash) becomes required and the Stop hook refuses to end the turn until it is invoked, once per turn.
expectations: Stop returns decision block while it is pending
Stop with stop_hook_active true does not block (no loop)

evals.prompt: please run the tests and check the logs then pause
evals.expected_output: No skill is named, nothing is required, and an Edit of a file that was Read is allowed.
expectations: No SKILL GATE context is injected

evals.prompt: (read gate) edit a file that was never Read, then one changed on disk after the Read
evals.expected_output: READ GATE blocks both cases; a fresh Read clears it.
expectations: Edit without a Read exits 2 with READ GATE not been Read
Edit after the file changed on disk exits 2 with READ GATE changed on disk
Edit after a new Read is allowed

evals.prompt: use the tdd skill for this, actually skip skills
evals.expected_output: 'skip skills' clears the required list for the session, so edits are not gated.
expectations: After a prompt containing 'skip skills', required is empty and Edit is allowed
